question:
In the sentence: "...taking proactive measures can help adults lead more fulfilling and balanced lives."

Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to “proactive” as used in the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Reactive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"proactive"** means:

 
 
• Taking action by causing change and not only reacting to change when it happens. (सक्रिय उपाय)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The management team is proactive in identifying potential problems and addressing them before they arise.
 
• The word **"reactive"** means:
 
 
• Acting in response to a situation rather than creating or controlling it. (प्रतिक्रियाशील)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Instead of being proactive, he prefers to be reactive and deal with issues as they come.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reactive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Positive** (सकारात्मक): Having a good effect or favorable.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a positive attitude towards life.
 
 
 
• **Aggressive** (आक्रामक): Ready to attack or confront; forcefully pursuing aims.
 
 
• **Example:** He took an aggressive approach to secure the deal.
 
 
 
• **Responsible** (जिम्मेदार): Having an obligation to do something as part of a job or role.
 
 
• **Example:** Being responsible for the team's success is important.
